description: This file defines the IAreaProvider interface, which specifies methods and properties for providing and managing render areas within the MigraDoc rendering engine.

classes.name: IAreaProvider
classes.description: An interface representing a provider that supplies areas for rendering in the document layout process.

methods.name: GetNextArea
methods.description: Returns the next Area object to render into, advancing the provider state.

methods.name: ProbeNextArea
methods.description: Returns the next Area object to render into without changing the provider state.

methods.name: AreaFieldInfos
methods.description: A property returning FieldInfos related to the current area context.

methods.name: IsAreaBreakBefore
methods.description: Determines if an area break is required before rendering at the specified layout location.

methods.name: PositionVertically
methods.description: Adjusts the vertical position of an element relative to the current area based on layout info.

methods.name: PositionHorizontally
methods.description: Adjusts the horizontal position of an element relative to the current area based on layout info.

methods.name: StoreRenderInfos
methods.description: Stores rendering information for elements on the current area.
